one_line: A series: part two answers the question part one raised, and links back to it in the caption.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman in a navy T-shirt in a bright living room holds a small pink pacifier near her chest, eyes on the lens. Said and subtitled: 'שימוש במוצץ יכול להשפיע על הדיבור'. White headline box; tips promised at 0:04.
q1_hook.why: A concern-based claim, said to the lens with the object in hand and repeated as word captions and a headline box, passes the skip test (H1, H4, H6, T3). The promise of tips at 0:04 gives a reason to stay. The claim sounds medical and has no source on screen (K4).

beats.what: Claim, then 'אלה הדברים שאתם יכולים לעשות'; the pacifier in hand
beats.why: The problem, then a promise of tips.

beats.what: Two pacifier stills with green and red hearts; 'העדיפו מוצצים' (0:07), 'עגולים' (0:09), 'פחות לחץ על החך'
beats.why: Tip 1 is visible at a glance.

beats.what: Back to her alone; 'חשוב שהוא יתאים למבנה של הפה', 'חכו רגע'
beats.why: Tip 2 is talk only, with nothing new to see.

beats.what: A small clip of a mother holding a baby; 'האם אפשר ... כמו חיבוק'
A clip of a sleeping baby; 'אחרי ההירדמות, להחזיר', 'סגרו את השפתיים'
A clock icon fills; a mother carries a newborn; 'לצמצם את הזמן', 'רק למצבים'
Plain frame again; 'נסו לגמול מהמוצץ מוקדם ככל האפשר', 'הבריאות'
Clock icons; 'משך השימוש ותדירות'; a child's open mouth at 1:06; 'המנשך'
beats.why: The key point, with a few images.

beats.what: SPEAK lip stickers; 'הכנתי לכם מדריך', 'הגיבו מדריך בתגובות'; Follow sticker 'עקבו'

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Comment word 'מדריך' for a language guide (1:10 to 1:17, said, boxed, and in the caption), plus a Follow sticker 'עקבו אחרי' (1:16 to 1:22). The caption links to part one.
q2_flow.why: The promise of a tip list sets a structure viewers follow (K4, R7). Pictures and icons come every 5 to 10 s, but between them she talks to the lens for long stretches (R3). The main point comes at 0:55, then 25 s go to asks (R1). At 82 s it is long for a tip list (R2).

q3_cta.what: 1:10 to 1:17 (said, subtitled, boxed): 'הכנתי לכם מדריך... הגיבו מדריך בתגובות ואשלח לכם'. Then 'עקבו אחרי לתכנים נוספים בנושא התפתחות שפה ודיבור' with a Follow sticker (1:16 to 1:22). Caption repeats both.
q3_cta.why: A comment word that delivers a free guide is a legitimate keyword, said, shown and repeated in the caption after the value (C3, C6). Follow is a second action (C1). The guide is introduced only in the last 12 s, in a box in the bottom 35% (F2).

q4_shown.what: She holds the pacifier all Reel. Two product stills with hearts 0:09 to 0:13; clips of a mother and baby 0:24, a sleeping baby 0:30, a clock icon 0:37, a newborn in a wrap 0:42, a child's open mouth 1:06. No price.
q4_shown.why: Authority comes from her role, said in the caption, and a Ministry of Health line (transcript at 0:50); each tip gets one picture (S6). The clips are stock-like and the claims carry no source on screen (K4). Several images show faces of children (S5).

q5_edit.what: One continuous take of about 82 s with 5 cuts (near 8, 13, 29, 43, 48 s) where the framing shifts; inset images every 5 to 10 s. Bold word-by-word subtitles, boxed text in the last 15 s. Ends on the CTA.
q5_edit.why: Few cuts and long talking stretches are slow, and the inserts only partly restore the pace (E2, R3). Word captions keep the eye moving (E4), but the box plus the sticker crowd the end (T2). It ends on the ask (E8), after 82 s (R2).

q6_topic.what: Six ways to lower pacifier harm, and when to wean, from a speech therapist. Serves parents of babies and toddlers who use pacifiers, following part one.
q6_topic.why: It gives something to do after the earlier worry, so it respects a real concern without alarm (K6). It states that she is 'not against' pacifiers and that duration and frequency matter most (K4). Weaning near age one ties it to a life stage (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod, static, eye level, in a bright living room with window light and a plant behind her. She stands facing the lens, one hand holding the pacifier up. No child on camera; children appear only in inserts.
q7_filmed.why: Looking at the lens gives the direct 'to you' feel (F6, H4). A clean, lit room and a lapel mic look homemade but sharp (H8, F7). The pacifier is small in the frame and the fuzzy item distracts (F4). Boxed captions and inserts sit low in the frame (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold white word-by-word subtitles with a dark outline, 1 to 3 words, at about 55 to 60% of the frame height ('העדיפו מוצצים', 'עגולים', 'חכו רגע'). Opening box: 'שימוש במוצץ יכול להשפיע על הדיבור ועל מראה הפנים' (0:00 to 0:04). Two end boxes: 'הכנתי לכם מדריך שיעזור לעודד את השפה והדיבור של הילדים שלכם' and 'הגיבו מדריך בתגובות' (1:10), 'עקבו אחרי לתכנים נוספים...' with a Follow sticker (1:16).
q8_text.caption: 'שימוש במוצץ יכול להשפיע על הדיבור, על הלסת ועל המנשך.' About 140 words: the credential 'כקלינאית תקשורת', a link and pointer to part one, 'אני לא נגד מוצצים', the comment-word offer for the guide, a follow ask. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Keyword subtitles and an opening box work muted (T1, T2, T3), but they sit in the middle and lower frame, and the long end boxes sit in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption opens with the hook, names the credential and links to part one, with the same CTA (T7, C6). No hashtags.

weak_points: Eighty-two seconds of mostly talk; medical claims with no on-screen source; two asks with the guide offered last; boxed text in the bottom band; a distracting fuzzy item on the pacifier; stock-like children's images.
lumebook_takeaway: A two-part series: part two answers part one's question and links back. Offer one free guide for one comment word. Hands and book, no child.
not_verified: What the pink item with a grey fuzzy part is (it looks like a pacifier with a microphone cover); whether the inserted children are hers; music (none evident). Whether part one (Db6Bi-nMywx, linked in the caption) is the same series. Correction: the opening headline box is at about 66 to 72% of the frame height and the CTA appears from 1:10, not 1:17. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
